root_cause: pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype returns True for pandas BooleanDtype, routing nullable boolean columns to float median imputation; CleaningPipeline.apply lacked a per-step exception guard.
lessons_learned: GitHub /search/issues allows max 5 AND/OR/NOT operators per query; keep ISSUE_QUERIES <= 4 OR terms.
Always check /issues/{num}/timeline for cross-referenced PRs before cloning so we skip issues already being fixed.
Pre-filter cheap issue fields before calling /repos/{owner}/{repo} to stay well under the 60 req/hr unauthenticated GitHub rate limit.
Check git user.name/user.email before committing and pass fallback -c author flags or remind user to configure git identity.

root_cause: _responsible_ai_badges lacked an id DESC tie-breaker on ORDER BY started_at DESC; secfoo assessment list omitted the Responsible AI column; E2E fixtures/tests lacked real-run coherence, Critical tier, rating-vs-findings independence, and intermediate reopen checks.
lessons_learned: Adding a column to a Rich CLI table can cause 80-column CliRunner tests to truncate existing cells; run all CLI table tests and pass env={'COLUMNS': '200'} where full cell text is asserted.
Always pair ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1 with , id DESC in SQLite so back-to-back runs with equal timestamps deterministically select the latest row.
Avoid blanket negative substring assertions on HTML pages and strip info-tip <details> blocks when matching stat-card labels.

root_cause: TracekitAgents._gate in tracekit/integrations/openai_agents.py and tracekit_hooks.pre in tracekit/integrations/claude_agent_sdk.py called fail_open() without passing _class_of(tool), causing per-class fail_modes (such as shell: open) to be ignored in favor of default; docs/limits.md row 78 also still listed OpenAI Agents, Claude Agent SDK, and CrewAI as default-only.
lessons_learned: When a repo lists a native dependency without a Python 3.15 wheel (e.g., google-re2) and provides a pure-Python fallback (regex), install the repo editable with --no-deps plus the remaining deps.
Patch shared stub tool registries locally with mock.patch.object in regression tests rather than mutating global contract fixtures.
Check CONTRIBUTING.md and issue instructions for DCO sign-off requirements and use git commit -s when required.

root_cause: _literal/_value_repr in config_writer.py and _value_repr in fixtures_writer.py wrapped multi-line strings in triple quotes guarding only against '"""' inside the value, causing SyntaxError on trailing '"'/'\', SyntaxWarning on invalid escapes, and silent corruption on escape sequences like '\n', '\f', or '\r'.
lessons_learned: Pass GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) to discover_github.py when gh CLI is authenticated, and fall back to inspecting bug issues in discovered active repos if /search/issues hits a secondary rate limit.

Never rely on ast.literal_eval(f'"""{value}"""') == value alone for triple-quoted code generation: strings with invalid escapes like '\p' pass equality while emitting SyntaxWarning, so reject backslashes and trailing quotes before considering triple quotes.

Check README/CI for the intended pytest target (e.g., pytest tests/) when repo-root collection hits example fixtures, and use --ignore-requires-python on Python 3.15 if the repo's upper cap excludes 3.15.

root_cause: _derive_mellea_package_name in compile/compiler.py only replaced hyphens/spaces and stripped underscores without checking str.isidentifier() or non-identifier characters, turning digit-prefixed names like 1password into 1password_mellea and failing lint_parseable with SyntaxError: invalid decimal literal.
lessons_learned: Normalise characters that are not valid Python identifier-continue characters before .strip('_') and prefix '_' when not pkg.isidentifier() so leading digits (including after stripping leading underscores) always yield valid package names.
Exclude .venv, .git, and __pycache__ when grepping from a repo root to avoid slow virtualenv traversals.

root_cause: The pin-consistency test's parametrized list covered only mcp.py, claude_code.py, and langgraph.py, leaving pi.py untested for hardcoded mellea pins despite it using MELLEA_PIN since #74.
lessons_learned: When adding a new export target that uses a shared constant, immediately add it to any consistency tests that enumerate targets to prevent silent coverage gaps.

root_cause: lint_bundled_asset_path_resolution in compile/lints.py only skipped fixtures/, intermediate/, and __pycache__ via _is_skipped_path, causing copied companion directories (scripts/, references/, assets/) to be linted as Step 5 generated code.
lessons_learned: Always check gh pr list --search "<num> OR <symbol>" --state all in addition to /issues/{num}/timeline, since contributors sometimes open PRs without linking the issue number.

When updating a shared skip predicate (_is_skipped_path) used by multiple lints, gate companion-directory exclusion behind a keyword flag (skip_bundled=True) so unrelated lints keep their exact scope.

root_cause: _classify_exception in compile/smoke_check.py did not inspect fixture.context or run_dir for FileNotFoundError/NotADirectoryError raised on missing or placeholder fixture input paths, causing smoke-check runs of file-input skills to fail instead of skip.
lessons_learned: Check exc.filename/exc.filename2 resolved relative to run_dir AND bounded error-message patterns when classifying FileNotFoundError/NotADirectoryError from fixture inputs, since custom exceptions raised as FileNotFoundError(msg) leave exc.filename as None.

Always verify on-disk state (resolved_cand.exists() / is_dir()) before attributing a FileNotFoundError/NotADirectoryError to a fixture input path so missing internal files inside a valid existing directory still fail the smoke check.

root_cause: _format_message_anthropic in libs/vertexai/langchain_google_vertexai/_anthropic_utils.py forwarded unrecognized OpenAI Responses function_call content blocks unchanged and converted non-Anthropic reasoning blocks into thinking blocks instead of filtering foreign blocks out.
lessons_learned: When porting cross-provider message filters from langchain-anthropic to sibling integrations like ChatAnthropicVertex, verify whether the sibling sets response_metadata['model_provider']; because ChatAnthropicVertex leaves it unset, allow None alongside 'anthropic' for native v1 reasoning blocks while always dropping OpenAI function_call blocks.

In monorepos with package-scoped pyproject.toml (e.g. libs/vertexai/pyproject.toml), run pytest and ruff check/format with the subpackage config so strict-markers, filterwarnings, and ruff lint/format rules are applied accurately.

root_cause: _RUNTIME_DEFAULTS_PATH in compile/claude_directives.py and _PI_PROMPTS_DIR / Path('.claude') / Path('.claude/schemas') in compile/backends/pi.py resolved assets relative to CWD instead of the installed package, causing compiles outside the repo root to read missing/foreign files and silently fall back to built-in runtime defaults.
lessons_learned: Check whether candidate issues from discover_github.py depend on unmerged open PRs (e.g. EvoScientist#899 on #686, EvoScientist#900 on #891) or were deferred by maintainers (PCNtoolkit#652) before committing to implementation.

When replacing CWD-relative asset lookups with package-anchored resolution, audit existing unit tests that use monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path) as a proxy for missing/custom files and decouple them via explicit keyword args or monkeypatched package paths.
